svg.title: The Branch Chart: Red-ink anatomical plate
svg.desc: The Branch Chart (1D): an anatomical plate in fine red ink on vellum. Vessels branch from a glowing point, the raft, like a river delta; the lit junction shows three branches marked with current arrows, tendril ticks, width and a calm-pool ring, while patrols stay hidden. The brothers' counter pieces stand on the branches as votes, and a pulse line along the foot shortens as the junction's time runs out.
